title: Trophy-case references
summary: A trophy case includes jokes referencing The Legend of Zelda, Doctor Who and the 2012 Mayan-calendar end-of-world panic.

title: Zork.exe
summary: A file named Zork.exe appears during the computer-extraction sequence, referencing the classic interactive-fiction game Zork.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare arcade
summary: An arcade table labeled Call of Duty: Modern Warfare appears in the common room.
connection: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare reference

title: Hidden teddy bears
summary: Teddy bears are documented on several Ghosts multiplayer maps including Sovereign, Stormfront, Flooded, Siege and Freight.
connection: Recurring Call of Duty Easter-egg motif

title: ZAP snowman effect
summary: Shooting the sparkling transformers in the correct sequence can trigger a temporary snowman-style death effect on Cryptids.

title: NEVERSOFT / Always Hard
summary: Shooting letters on the car-wash sign to spell NEVERSOFT unlocks the secret intel 'Always Hard'.

title: Riley name reference
summary: Riley, the Ghosts military dog, is documented as a reference to Simon 'Ghost' Riley from Modern Warfare 2.
